create_ui_canvas_with_label: use UIManager.update_canvas to add a UILabel with custom text and font size to the center canvas
create_ui_toggle_button: use UIContext.toggle to create a toggle button with true and false labels and a tooltip
create_ui_clickable_button: use UIContext.button to create a clickable UIButton with text and check presses via is_button_pressed
create_ui_list_item: use UIContext.list_item to create a list item with left and right text labels and custom color
clear_ui_canvases: use UIManager.clear_canvas or clear_all_canvases to remove all UI elements from one or all canvases
